name: Brochan
text: Brochan is a variant spelling of Brychan. Brychan was a legendary king of south Wales. A family of saints claimed descent from him. The name also marks the old territory of Brycheiniog.

okr.objective: Describe Brochan, a variant spelling of Brychan.
key_results: It is a variant spelling of Brychan.
Brychan was a legendary king of south Wales.
His name gave the territory of Brycheiniog.
